1.) Check out and download "Master Data File" off windchill file path: Projects > CMU Engineering Data > Folders > Data Release - Work In Process > Test Master.    NOTE: This nameplate file needs to remain open                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             2.) Under the "Error Log" worksheet erase all errors before begining                                                                                                                           3.) Are there any changes that need new model numbers to be created in the Master List Workbook?                                                         If YES, create them and generate data with the previous released version of the nameplate program and continue on to 4).                                     If NO, continue on to step 6).
4.) In the "Master Data file" under the "Lit_Mater_XX" (XX being the discrete digits ex. TC) worksheet add new model numbers at the bottom of the list in the 1st column. The 1st column comes from columns 5th -18th. 
5.) Run “CallCopyLitertureData” at the worksheet you adding on new models.
6.) With the nameplate program open, run the macro “MassGenLitMaster”
7.) Run the “MassCompareLitData” Macro.
8.) Check any difference on each sheet. The difference will shows on the columns of  “CFQ and “CFR”
9.) On the “Error Log” tab, verify that all changes were expected
10.) Once you have verified all changes, run “CallCopyLitertureData”
11.)  Run the GetLiteratureSheets to confirm copy for all worksheets.
12.) You can now update the revisions tab and save the file.
